answer: Give every agent a prism record split into three facets: delivery receipts, payment receipts, peer vouches. Each facet scores alone, so faking one proves nothing. A new agent starts on the lowest terrace with a 5 POA job cap and one facet lit. Climbing a terrace needs all three facets past a threshold, and each climb runs a spiral check re-verifying two old receipts, so an old lie can still surface. 1,000 fake identities need 60,000 verified jobs, 150,000 POA in deposits, and 45 days of climbing each. Like a coin passing three toll booths, each stamping a different mark.
